newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bond futures outstrip cash.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bond futures outstrip cash.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Futures rose strongly, breaking a strong resistance point but the 10-year cash remained blocked at 90 basis points over the Bunds. Foreign markets to set trend. *June 97 futures up 37 basis points at 108.29 *Feb 07 cash 99.85 vs 99.75. Yld 6.64 vs 6.66 Monday *Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -7 bps vs -5 bps
